capabilities.name: Serial number and IMEI repair
capabilities.details: Backs up changed records, verifies readback and checks persistence after restart. Use identifiers assigned to the phone.

capabilities.name: Bluetooth and Wi-Fi factory addresses
capabilities.details: Optional assigned addresses with record backup, readback and restore. The effective radio address is not independently verified; Android privacy addresses may differ.

capabilities.name: Record backup and restore
capabilities.details: Serial and IMEI snapshots plus Bluetooth/Wi-Fi transaction backups. Not a full phone, calibration, photo or app backup.

capabilities.name: Connection and mode detection
capabilities.details: Android ADB and META inspection, supported META entry and return to Android. Requires the appropriate USB drivers.

capabilities.name: OS package preparation
capabilities.details: Catalog selection, checksum verification and package review. Checksums do not authenticate a publisher or establish phone compatibility.

capabilities.name: Powered-off phone diagnostics
capabilities.details: Reads supported preloader/BROM chip information. A chip match does not identify an exact phone model.

capabilities.name: OS installation and formatting
capabilities.details: All Download Only, Firmware Upgrade, Format Only and Format + Download operations are blocked until exact device-to-release compatibility is verified.

limitations: Other repair firmware profiles and phone models are not supported.
Automatic identifier allocation, device security provisioning and authentication bypass are not provided.
